verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no built-in feature that generates AI insights or suggestions from a user's data inside Make. The Make AI Agents app is an agentic-automation building block a user would have to configure. The MCP server exposes scenarios to external AI clients like Claude and ChatGPT, which puts the AI outside the product. The analytics endpoint returns raw analytics data, not AI-generated insights.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
